summary: Configured datauser with a persistent, filesystem-enforced 100M XFS quota for /srv/data. Enforcement and reboot persistence were verified successfully.
actions_performed: Created datauser and /srv/data with datauser ownership.
Enabled persistent XFS user quotas at boot.
Applied 100M soft and hard block limits to datauser.
Confirmed oversized writes fail with “Disk quota exceeded.”
Rebooted node1 and verified changed boot identity, recovered data, quota state, and enforcement.

evidence.requirement: datauser has a filesystem-enforced 100M storage limit under /srv/data
evidence.summary: The account/path were created, XFS accounting and enforcement were ON with 100M soft/hard limits, and a 105M write failed with Disk quota exceeded.

evidence.requirement: Quota configuration persists and remains enforced after restart
evidence.summary: After reboot, /srv/data remained on XFS with usrquota, the 100M limits remained active, marker data was intact, and another oversized write was rejected.

Captured the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID from fccef26b-b4ec-40ee-9c60-42bc9a280250 to d384b97f-16a0-4ba3-a055-14e904399c03, and direct post-restart proof of system health, data integrity, quota recovery, and enforcement.
